text:
frank: heads upmdashrunning the python quickstart from my windows laptop behind corp NTLM proxy. first POST to /v1/chat fails with 401 then 403 billing_unprovisioned even though console shows billing enabled. token looks valid locally. anyone seen proxy strip the Authorization header?

frank: logs from our side: ```
2026-03-25T08:12:01Z proxy: incoming POST /v1/chat headers=[Host, User-Agent, Content-Type, Proxy-Authorization]
2026-03-25T08:12:01Z gateway: forwarded request missing Authorization header
2026-03-25T08:12:01Z caller=client.go status=401 msg="unauthorized: missing auth header"
2026-03-25T08:12:02Z caller=client.go status=403 msg="billing: workspace_unprovisioned"
```

liz: yep this happens with some corporate proxies doing NTLM/Negotiate. They replace Authorization with Proxy-Authorization when negotiating. The gateway never sees the bearer token.

frank: workarounds that fixed it for me: 1) set NO_PROXY for api.redwood.ai or run quickstart outside the proxy; or 2) configure the proxy to tunnel (CONNECT) for api.redwood.ai so it doesn't strip headers; or 3) add x-redwood-org header as temporary stopgap.

tom: also SDK note: the python client surfaced the 403 as "workspace_unprovisioned" which misled the user. We should detect "proxy-stripped-auth" by checking for Proxy-Authorization header present but no Authorization on incoming requests and return a helpful error explaining common corporate-proxy causes and the NO_PROXY workaround.

marie: agreed. I'll open INF-5055: "detect proxy-stripped auth + better onboarding message" and INF-5056: "quickstart: document NO_PROXY and include docker run example that shows bypassing corp proxy". Assign to devex and eng-infra respectively.

frank: sample quick curl that worked for me (windows environment):```
set NO_PROXY=api.redwood.ai
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer %TOKEN%" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

liz: for corporate runners we should add a diagnostic step in quickstart: call /v1/health and echo whether gateway saw Authorization header. that would surface proxy problems before hitting billing checks.

devex-bot: note: payg-provisioning-guard v1.3.4 deployed 2026-03-25T07:45:00Z  tightened identity checks; creating INF-5055/INF-5056 for DX improvements.

frank: thanks everyone, NO_PROXY workaround got me a first-call 200 and stream start. saved the onboarding flow. :thumbsup:
